## About SAOC

SAOC exists to promote the culture, hybridisation and appreciation of orchids across South Africa. We do this through a federated network of 21 societies, a nationally accredited judging system first standardised in 1990, and our annual publication Orchids South Africa.


## Affiliated Societies

- **Alfred County Orchid Society** meets: 3rd Sunday of the Month, 14:00
- **Border Orchid Society** (EC) — meets: 2nd Wednesday of the month, 18:00
- **Cape Orchid Society** (WC) — meets: every fourth Tuesday evening of the month, 7:00 PM — Founded in 1957, the Cape Orchid Society is the oldest orchid group in South Africa and a founder member of the South African Orchid Council. The COS strives to bring together those interested in orchids in order to promote and encourage the culture and conservation of orchids, as well as to educate and provide a base for all other orchid-related activities. The COS began with monthly meetings, which still continue today, providing informative presentations, practical growing advice and an opportunity for growers to display and discuss their plants and flowers. The Society hosts a number of events throughout the year, including two shows in which growers showcase their blooms, an auction, greenhouse open days and hikes. We also provide members with a newsletter, monthly guest speakers, local judging, and much, much, more!
- **East Rand Orchid Society** (GP) — meets: 2nd Saturday of the Month, 14:00
- **Eastern Province Orchid Society** (EC) — meets: The 2nd Thursday of the month, 7:00 PM
- **Gonubie Orchid Society** meets: First Sunday of each Month, 2:00 PM — Gonubie Orchid Society was formed in 1998 by Eric Dodd and became affiliated to SAOC in May 1999. The Society first met at Pioneer Nursery in Gonubie. In 2014, the Society moved their meetings to the Gonubie Hotel. The Society has always been a strong Society and is well known for it’s yearly Orchid Shows. It’s membership has been strong with an average of 30 members since it’s establishment. Since May 2026, we meet at the Beacon Bay Bowling Club.
- **Highway Orchid Society** meets: Every second Saturday of the month except December, 1:30 PM
- **Lowveld Orchid Group** meets: 3rd Thursday of every 2nd month, 16:00
- **Natal Orchid Society** (KZN) — meets: 3rd Saturday of every month, 09:30
- **Northern Gauteng Orchid Society** meets: 2nd Saturday of the month, 2:00 PM — The Northern Gauteng Orchid Society (NGOS), formerly the Orchid Society of Northern Transvaal (ONT) was founded in 1967 and is the fourth oldest orchid society in South Africa. Based in Pretoria, it serves the Northern Gauteng and adjacent region. The society’s emblem is Angraecum stella-africae.
- **Orchid Society of the Southern Cape** meets: Last Saturday of the month unless changed, 2:00 PM
- **Phalaborwa Orchid Society** meets: 2nd Sunday of every 2nd month, 12:00
- **Pietermaritzberg Orchid Society** meets: Second Saturday of the month, 2:00 PM — The Pietermaritzburg Orchid Society started in May 1978. It is a long-established society that serves all the orchid enthusiasts in the greater Msunduzi District in the midlands of KwaZulu-Natal. It was established to promote, develop and foster interest in culture, propagation, conservation and the study of orchids.
- **Plantae Orchid Group** 
- **Rustenburg Orchid Society** meets: Please email to confirm venue and time
- **Tygerberg Orchid Group** meets: Every 3rd Saturday of the month, 9:30 AM — Established in November 1985 as a non-profit association, the TOG is an affiliate of the South African Orchid Council (SAOC) which is the governing body managed by a Board of directors nominated by all the different societies in the RSA. Membership is available to all people interested in orchids.
- **Vlakte Orgideevereniging** meets: Saturday, 12:00 PM
- **Walker Bay Orchid Society** meets: 2nd Saturday of each Month, 2:00 PM
- **Witwatersrand Orchid Society** meets: Last Sunday of every month, 1:30 PM — The Witwatersrand Orchid Society (WOS) is one of the oldest orchid societies in South Africa. Established in 1963 under its original name, the Transvaal Orchid Society, the Society has a long-standing history of promoting an appreciation and understanding of orchids and their cultivation.
- **Wolkberg Orchid Society** meets: 3rd Sunday of the month, 14:00
- **Zululand Orchid Society** meets: Every 4th Sunday of the month except December, 10:00 AM

## Scope Boundary
SAOC covers orchids in cultivation: growing, showing, hybridising, judging, community.
Wild orchid conservation and identification → WOSA (Wild Orchids of Southern Africa): wosa.org.za
